dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped structures exhibit sharp pixel-intensity transitions from dark brown backgrounds to light cream perimeters. The most prominent dorsal annuli show irregular, non-uniform circularity with jagged outer edges and darker interior cores.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of solid light-colored pixel clusters located primarily on the lower lateral flank and near the pectoral flipper; these clusters lack an internal gradient and appear as compact, asymmetrical high-intensity points.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of three prominent dorsal annuli form an obtuse triangle on the upper mid-section. A secondary set of four annuli on the posterior lateral side forms a rough trapezoidal geometric relationship.
